searchText: About BPO. EIP-7840 & EIP-7892 say that the values should be integers (`"target": 3`), while in the EEST fixtures they are rendered as hex strings (`"target": "0x03"`). We should change the EIPs or the tests. hex for data, numbers for integers pls
